description: This file implements the Python bindings for the torch::Stream class in PyTorch, including creation, wrapping, comparison, and stream management functions.

classes.name: THPStream
classes.description: Python wrapper for torch::Stream, providing stream management and synchronization functionalities.

methods.name: THPStream_pynew
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new torch.Stream object from Python arguments.

methods.name: THPStream_Wrap
methods.description: Wraps a c10::Stream object into a Python torch.Stream object.

methods.name: THPStream_get_device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the stream.

methods.name: THPStream_query
methods.description: Checks if the stream is queryable.

methods.name: THPStream_wait_event
methods.description: Makes the stream wait for an event.

methods.name: THPStream_wait_stream
methods.description: Makes the stream wait for another stream.

methods.name: THPStream_record_event
methods.description: Records an event on the stream.

methods.name: THPStream_repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stream.

methods.name: THPStream_hash
methods.description: Hash function for the stream object.

methods.name: THPStream_enter
methods.description: Enters the stream context, setting it as current.

methods.name: THPStream_exit
methods.description: Exits the stream context, restoring previous stream.

methods.name: THPStream_richcompare
methods.description: Rich comparison method for stream objects.

methods.name: THPStream_init
methods.description: Initializes the torch.Stream class in the Python module.
